data: Lost during landing in 1999; the failure led NASA to review its “faster, better, cheaper” approach
Skeleton entry for /fleet (PRD-012 v0.2 / Phase A scaffold). Builder + agency + first-flight per public sources. Specs and gallery TBD in later phases.

Mars Polar Lander was a NASA lander built by Lockheed Martin. Contact was lost during its descent to the Martian south polar region in December 1999. Coming months after the loss of Mars Climate Orbiter, the failure led NASA to review its “faster, better, cheaper” approach.
Confirmed water ice in Martian soil
First successful Mars lander; biology experiments
Second US Mars surface lander (Utopia Planitia 1976-09-03). Twin of Viking 1 lander; ran biology, soil chemistry + meteorology until 1980
UK/ESA Mars lander from Mars Express (2003). Silent on arrival; HiRISE found it intact in 2015 — a solar panel had failed to deploy
